name: Media Converter
description: Browse your Jellyfin library, pick a video, and convert it to a different container/codec using the server's own bundled ffmpeg - automatically using whichever hardware transcoder (Intel QSV, Nvidia NVENC, AMD AMF) is already configured in Jellyfin's playback settings, or CPU if none is enabled - either replacing the original file in place or creating a new variant alongside it, with a live progress bar.
overview: Convert library media files from the dashboard, using this server's configured ffmpeg hardware transcoder or CPU.

versions.changelog: 1.0.3: Searching now matches series names too, showing an episode picker (ordered by season/episode) instead of requiring the exact episode title. The dashboard also surfaces API errors visibly instead of failing silently. 1.0.2: Fixed the plugin always reporting itself as version 0.0.0.0, which made Jellyfin's plugin details page fail with "An error occurred while getting the plugin details from the repository." 1.0.1: Fixed the dashboard page's Search/Convert/Cancel buttons never responding to clicks - a pageshow event guard was checking the wrong DOM node and always bailing out before wiring up any listeners. 1.0.0: Initial release: dashboard library browser, convert dialog with curated presets plus an advanced raw ffmpeg-args override, replace/variant modes, and live job progress.
